name: an unclaimed receipt read at its own instant is an orphan and likely UNASKED; one whose pass wrote no coverage is not
notes: §3 v1.9: a gmail.receipt pass that parsed an opened receipt covers only that message's instant. One such pass (acct-a): the Stripe receipt sent 14:03, opened and parsed at 14:10. No claims.

o1 (Stripe 4999 USD, 14:03): its own source saw its occurredAt (the 14:03 point, synced 14:10 ≤ evaluatedAt 15:00), gmail.receipt is listed for purchase.made, no claim took it → an orphan (§3). Anchor = occurredAt 14:03 (§7, not a calendar row).

Attribution (§7): muse session at 14:00, within ±10 min of 14:03 → agentSessionActive 4000; idle [13:55, 14:10] covers [14:01, 14:03] → userIdle 3000; no signatures, no activity entries. muse = 7000 bp = 7/10 ≥ 6000 → UNASKED, attribution 'likely', reasons unasked.session, unasked.idle (agent muse).
Finality (§7): muse's adapter synced 14:50 ≥ anchor + beforeClaimMin + graceMin = 14:35 → FINAL.

o2 (Uber 1250 USD, sent 14:04:30, stored at 14:20): the pass that read it wrote no coverage (a refused row, §3), and no point holds 14:04:30, so o2 is no orphan although muse's session and the idle interval would score it 7/10 too. A point says only that its own message was read.
